comparison.objective: Remove a hidden obstruction and insert a peg without over-force; candidate screens a mixed batch.
comparison.physical_skill: Force-sensitive diagnosis, tipping out one ball, and peg insertion versus controlled pour and granular agitation.
comparison.success_condition: Ball removed and peg fully seated without tripping the force latch versus recovered media mass and retained washers.
comparison.reason: Incidental removal of a ball is not mixture separation through apertures.
